content.short: Intergalactic Beastiary is a utility-based NFT gaming project on Cardano featuring upgradeable characters.
content.description: Intergalactic Beastiary is an innovative NFT project on the Cardano blockchain that combines digital art with interactive gaming utility. The collection features unique 'Beasts' from different galaxies, each designed with AI-driven aesthetics and hand-polished details. Holders can participate in the 'Battle for Intergalactic Treasury' game, using their NFTs to compete for rewards. A core feature of the project is the ability to enhance and upgrade NFTs through gameplay, improving their rarity and standing within the ecosystem. It bridges the gap between collectible art and active gaming.
